$comment: AutoStacc engine contract v1: one suggested value for a file, only when the job sent a vocabulary. field: kind, instrument, bpm, key or midiRole; value: a vocabulary value (bpm as a number in text). origin: where the strongest evidence came from (the asset_values origins: filename, folder-name, embedded, rule; analysis later). confidence: 0 to 1, a starting value to be calibrated. reasons: the evidence, for the review screen. A suggestion is never a fact.
